title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:te-modati-chadavu
canDo: I can read a Telugu word downwards as well as along, read a sentence with no word for is, and hold a whole passage about one room without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Twenty-five words about one room, carried by ఉంది and లేదు, with respect marked in the verb where the teacher gets ఉన్నారా and the farmer does not.
